DEVOTION 1.0.4 - first public build since 1.0.2 (includes the unreleased
1.0.3). No new game required. Many fixes found by DrHeisen's 1.0.2 audit.

REQUIEM USERS - LOAD ORDER: Devotion now ships its own
Scripts\TempleBlessingScript.pex, which Requiem's bugfix packs also ship.
In MO2, Devotion MUST sit below them or the shrine bug returns with no
warning. Check the MO2 Data tab - that file should list Devotion.

FIXED - SAVE DAMAGE
* Runaway stat drift (save-corrupting). 418 of 422 value-modifier effects
  were missing the Recover flag, so every on/off cycle baked the change in
  permanently - users reported -22131% Magic Resistance and -5000 armour.
* To repair an existing save: MCM > Player > Maintenance > Check stat
  damage, then Repair stats. Save first; it also clears permanent modifiers
  other mods placed on those values.
* Devotion could stop working permanently after one lost script tick.
* Uninstalling left effects behind, including Malacath's speed price.

FIXED - SHRINES (REQUIEM ONLY)
* Praying wiped every buff and gave nothing back. Requiem's bugfix packs
  dispel all your active effects at a shrine; normally masked by Requiem's
  blessing landing after, but Devotion deliberately grants no blessing, so
  only the loss remained. Praying no longer dispels, and still gives piety.
* Not on Requiem? You never had this. Base Skyrim does not dispel.

FIXED - GODS REACTING CORRECTLY
* Daedric pact prices and pool boons did nothing - they now move your
  maximum pool as described.
* Hermaeus Mora's Champion boon was mis-wired; now Alteration +20 and
  Fortify Magicka +20.
* 22 disfavor and neglect penalties were applying as bonuses.
* Azura's likes and dislikes never loaded at all.
* Killing a Thalmor who attacked you counted as unprovoked.
* A menu that could not open could sever the Bosmer Old Contract unasked.

ADDED
* Bosmer Green Pact food - eating meat now rewards keeping the pact (22
  vanilla/DLC meats). Eating plants is still the violation. Daily cap
  applies.
* Requiem food support (Torn Flesh, skeever, fox, bear, mammoth, sabrecat,
  troll, Wrothgar Tartare) - keyword-distributed, inert without Requiem.
* Check stat damage / Repair stats buttons.

IMPROVED
* Equipping an item is dramatically cheaper - reaction data is resolved
  once per load instead of sixteen times per equip.
* Every scored action costs far less; text formatting no longer runs 44
  passes per line; no more log line per corpse; quieter polling.
* Larger notifications on 1440p/4K, and the toast box now fits its text.
